description: This file defines an Android activity 'EditNoteActivity' responsible for creating and editing a note within a note-taking application. It manages user interactions such as inputting note details, applying formatting styles, and handling save/delete actions.

classes.name: EditNoteActivity
classes.description: Main activity class for editing or creating notes, managing UI components, handling user actions, and interacting with the notes repository.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and loads an existing note if note ID is provided.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu for saving and deleting notes.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections such as save, delete, or navigation.

methods.name: toggleStyle
methods.description: Applies or removes text styling (bold or italic) to the selected text in the content input field.

methods.name: loadNote
methods.description: Loads note data into the UI components from the repository based on the note ID.

methods.name: saveNote
methods.description: Validates input and saves or updates the note in the repository.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes the current note from the repository.
